summary: Tested mobile/tablet fixes for iPad experience. Verified: Expert Mode delete buttons (5/5 nodes have X delete buttons), Character Builder dropdown text visibility (all options visible with dark theme styling), 3D Library loads correctly with genre sections, BookReader with swipe gesture integration, Art Studio general functionality. Mobile joystick correctly shows only on touch devices (not in headless browser test).
critical_code_review_comments: isMobile() function correctly detects iPad via navigator.platform === 'MacIntel' && navigator.maxTouchPoints > 1
NodeDeleteButton component properly placed on all 5 node types (Character, Scene, Style, Reference, Combine, Output)
useSwipeGestures hook properly integrated in BookReader with visual feedback (swipeHint state)
Mobile joystick uses responsive sizing (w-28 sm:w-32 md:w-36) and safe-area-inset for proper positioning
All native select elements have colorScheme: 'dark' and explicit option styling for text visibility
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iPad/mobile fixes verified: (1) Expert Mode has delete X buttons on all nodes, (2) Character Builder dropdowns show visible text with dark colorScheme, (3) 3D Library joystick appears on touch devices only - not visible in headless browser (expected), (4) BookReader has swipe gestures integrated, (5) Book info card responsive styling is in place. The isMobile() function checks for touch capability which headless Chrome doesn't have.
